parsed.name: Tron1 运动桥接节点
parsed.description: 这是一个非实体的软件组件，用于将 ROS2 的 cmd_vel 速度指令桥接到 Tron1 的 WebSocket 接口，服务于移动机器人/移动底盘的运动控制。它负责建立连接、将速度命令归一化并转换为 Tron1 可用的比例格式、按固定频率发送运动指令，并在超时或关闭时发送停止命令。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that bridges ROS2 cmd_vel velocity commands to the Tron1 WebSocket interface for mobile robot/mobile base motion control. It handles connection setup, normalizes and converts velocity commands into the Tron1 ratio format, sends motion commands at a fixed rate, and issues a stop command on timeout or shutdown.

actions.description: 连接 Tron1 的 WebSocket 接口，并可按需执行重试。
actions.description_en: Connect to the Tron1 WebSocket interface, with optional retry logic.

actions.description: 接收 ROS2 的 cmd_vel 指令，并将其转换为 Tron1 使用的速度比例格式。
actions.description_en: Receive ROS2 cmd_vel commands and convert them into the velocity ratio format used by Tron1.

actions.description: 以约 30 Hz 持续发送运动命令，并在命令超时时自动发送停止指令。
actions.description_en: Continuously send motion commands at about 30 Hz and automatically issue a stop command when command timeout occurs.

actions.description: 关闭节点时发送停止命令并清理相关资源。
actions.description_en: Send a stop command and clean up related resources when the node shuts down.
